rss_measurement.tool: GNU time %M, benchmark-child whole-lifetime peak KiB on Linux; includes startup/setup/verification and small native pre-exec launch overhead; no Python-parent RSS floor, no incremental-heap claim

scope: Matched native executables, shuffled before/after per fixture. Same compiler/profile, runner and SQLite engine; only native registry lookup and native fingerprint differ. Shared host; no dynamic-runner timing or isolated-core claim.
